title: MiroshnikovaLab/Bertillot-et-al.-2025: Bertillot et al. 2026
description: Analysis code from Bertillot, F., Hervé, S., Outla, Z. et al., Heterogeneity co-evolves with architecture to determine colon cancer outcome (2026). It contains the notebooks for tumour architecture analysis of colorectal cancer tissue microarrays (tumour–stroma segmentation, architecture classification, morphology and neighbourhood features), nuclear shape analysis, and GeoMx spatial transcriptomics analysis. It also includes the pretrained tumour–stroma U-Net and the gene sets used for the GeoMx and single-cell analyses. The architecture U-Net, with ONNX exports and inference code, is at doi:10.5281/zenodo.20343193.
